  1) First, we lock SALES_DB.CUSTOMER in TD_MAP1 for write on a
     reserved RowHash to prevent global deadlock.
  2) Next, we lock SALES_DB.CUSTOMER in TD_MAP1 for write.
  3) We do an all-AMPs DELETE step in TD_MAP1 from SALES_DB.CUSTOMER by
     way of full table deletion with no residual conditions.  The size
     is estimated with high confidence to be 747 rows.  The estimated

  4) We do an INSERT step into SALES_DB.LOAD_LOG.  The estimated time
     for this step is 0.02 seconds.
  5) We spoil the parser's dictionary cache for the table.
  6) Finally, we send out an END TRANSACTION step to all AMPs involved
     in processing the request.
  -> No rows are returned to the user as the result of statement 1.
